question: Who among the following won the gold medal in the women's high jump event at the National Games in February 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pooja Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pooja Singh** won the **gold medal** in the **women's high jump event** at the **National Games held in February 2025.**
 
• The National Games are one of the premier sporting events in India, showcasing the talent and skills of athletes from various states and Union Territories.
 
• High jump is a track and field event in which athletes attempt to leap over a horizontal bar placed at measured heights without the aid of any equipment.
 
• **Pooja Singh** demonstrated exceptional **athletic skill, technique, and endurance** during the competition, earning her the top spot on the podium.
 
• The victory highlights her dedication and hard work as an athlete, contributing to her recognition in the national sports arena.
 
• The National Games provide a platform for athletes like **Pooja Singh** to gain exposure and prepare for international competitions such as the **Asian Games** and **Olympics.**

__
 
• **Vithya Ramraj**__

 __
 
• **Vithya Ramraj** is an Indian athlete specializing in **hurdles and sprinting events.**
 
• She gained recognition for her performance in **national and international track events.**
 
• Although she did not win the high jump event at the National Games in February 2025, she continues to excel in her areas of expertise.
 
 
 
• **Abhinaya Shetty**__
 __
 
• **Abhinaya Shetty** is a promising athlete known for her participation in various **track and field events.**
 
• She is continuously improving her performance, aiming to make her mark in national competitions.
 
 
 
• **Swapna Barman**__
 
 
• **Swapna Barman** is an Indian track and field athlete specializing in **heptathlon.**
 
• She gained fame after winning a **gold medal at the Asian Games 2018.**
 
• Though she did not participate in or win the high jump event at the National Games in February 2025, her achievements continue to inspire young athletes.
